name: Renferrel's Findings
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Renferrel's Findings carry research south to Tarren Mill. Apothecary Renferrel gathered the notes at the Sepulcher for Apothecary Lydon, who is helping brew the Forsaken's New Plague.

sections.title: A Plague in Development
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel records his work on the New Plague. The Royal Apothecary Society labours under direct orders from Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Dark Lady. Researchers scattered across Lordaeron must work together to achieve a breakthrough. Renferrel sends his findings south to Tarren Mill, where fellow researchers can build on his results.

sections.title: To Tarren Mill
sections.body: The papers link Silverpine Forest to Hillsbrad Foothills and the Forsaken's alchemical network. Apothecary Lydon awaits Renferrel's notes in Tarren Mill, where he can compare them with his own work against the living and the Scourge. Reliable couriers must cross Hillsbrad's contested roads; without them, the Society's scattered research would quickly stall.

faq.answer: Renferrel's Findings contain Apothecary Renferrel's latest research and experimental data from Silverpine Forest. The notes concern the Forsaken's work to brew a New Plague.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this research?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is to receive the documents. He conducts plague research in Tarren Mill, a Forsaken settlement in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why are the apothecaries sharing notes?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has ordered the Royal Apothecary Society to create a New Plague. The apothecaries believe comparing results will bring a breakthrough far more quickly than working alone.

faq.q: Where does Apothecary Renferrel conduct his experiments?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel conducts his experiments at the Sepulcher, the primary Forsaken outpost in the heart of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As an undead, you know these papers serve Sylvanas Windrunner's ambition: to perfect a New Plague against the Scourge and the living foes encroaching on Forsaken lands.
As a member of the Horde, you know couriers carrying Renferrel's papers connect outposts such as the Sepulcher and Tarren Mill, strengthening the Horde's foothold across Lordaeron.
